sources.title: Releasing dentate nucleus cells from Purkinje cell inhibition generates output from the cerebrocerebellum
sources.authors: Ishikawa T, Tomatsu S, Tsunoda Y, Lee J, Hoffman DS, Kakei S
sources.relevance: primary — establishes disinhibition as primary DCN output mechanism in primates
sources.key_data: DN burst activity co-occurs with PC suppression, not after rebound delay; conclusion: PC suppression is primary mechanism for DCN output generation

sources.title: Perineuronal Nets in the Deep Cerebellar Nuclei Regulate GABAergic Transmission and Delay Eyeblink Conditioning
sources.relevance: primary — PNN function in DCN, quantitative plasticity data

sources.title: The Role of Cerebellar Intrinsic Neuronal Excitability, Synaptic Plasticity, and Perineuronal Nets in Eyeblink Conditioning
sources.relevance: primary — comprehensive review of DCN plasticity mechanisms

key_data.learning_change: reduced AHP amplitude, reduced IA-like K+ current
key_data.LTP_requirement: MF→DCN LTP requires prior hyperpolarization (PC inhibition-gated)

sources.title: Aberrant outputs of glutamatergic neurons in deep cerebellar nuclei mediate dystonic movements
sources.authors: Wu XM, Lu B et al.
sources.relevance: primary — DCN cell type classification, disease mechanism

DCN_cell_types: glutamatergic (→thalamus, red nucleus, brainstem, spinal cord)
key_data.dystonia_mechanism: aberrant glutamatergic DCN neuron activation via PC disinhibition after SD

sources.title: Reverse-translational identification of a cerebellar satiation network
sources.relevance: primary — non-motor function of DCN (satiation circuit)

key_data.circuit: aDCN glutamatergic neurons → VTA dopamine neurons → ventral striatum
key_data.function: promotes satiation by sustaining dopamine baseline, attenuating phasic food-reward dopamine
key_data.human_finding: deep cerebellum is the only brain region with significant difference in Prader-Willi vs control fMRI

sources.title: Pathophysiology of Cerebellar Tremor: The Forward Model-Related Tremor and the Inferior Olive Oscillation-Related Tremor
sources.relevance: primary — DCN in forward model and Guillain-Mollaret triangle

key_data.long_loop: DCN → thalamus (VL) → motor cortex → pontine nuclei → mossy fibers → cerebellum
key_data.predictive_capacity: DCN output predicts motor state 200ms ahead (Kalman filter equivalent)

tremor_types.rhythmic_tremor: short loop disrupted, IO oscillations, regular

sources.title: Glycinergic projection neurons of the cerebellum
sources.relevance: supporting — DCN glycinergic cell type discovery

key_data.projection: ipsilateral vestibular nuclei and medullary reticular formation
key_data.significance: breaks assumption that all DCN projection neurons are glutamatergic

sources.title: Regulation of autism-relevant behaviors by cerebellar-prefrontal cortical circuits
sources.relevance: primary — DCN cognitive/social function via PFC circuit

key_data.circuit: cerebellar crus I/II → lateral DCN → VM thalamus → medial PFC
key_data.finding: activating crus I/II PCs improved social preference deficits and repetitive behaviors
key_data.implication: dentate/lateral DCN → prefrontal connection is a cognitive cerebellar pathway

sources.title: Modulatory Effects of Monoamines and Perineuronal Nets on Output of Cerebellar Purkinje Cells
sources.relevance: supporting — monoamine modulation of PC→DCN transmission; rebound firing properties

key_data.rebound_property: amplitude depends on duration and strength of hyperpolarization
key_data.monoamine_effect: 5-HT and NE reduce PC→DCN GABA release via presynaptic receptors
key_data.PNN_mechanism: K+ channel anchoring and Ca2+ buffering
